title: Gemma 2 Public Release
summary: Google officially released Gemma 2 to researchers and developers on June 27, 2024, in 9B and 27B parameter sizes.
significance: A dated public-release milestone in Google's Gemma family of open models, following the earlier May 2024 announcement that Gemma 2 would launch in June.

verification.note: Google's first-party June 27, 2024 announcement explicitly says Gemma 2 is officially releasing to researchers and developers globally and identifies 9B and 27B parameter sizes. Google's May 2024 developer announcement separately said Gemma 2 would launch in June. This candidate records the dated public-release milestone only; it does not convert the earlier announcement into a release event and does not infer development geography, ancestry, downstream influence, causality, or relationship edges.
